value.rationale: This natural maximal-control parameter and published real map are relevant to lightweight chaotic generators. A motivated exact finite-state recurrent-class census reveals rounding-place sensitivity: the nonzero period-five basin of 2026 states ceases to exist as a separate attractor and the period-22 orbit also vanishes, although only 2205 successors change. Such a targeted complete low-precision graph invariant is not predetermined by the classical eventual-periodicity principle or a generic well-known logistic table; it identifies a concrete design-reproducibility sensitivity and an exact test case.
